roadmap.title: Learn the basics and clear the campaign
roadmap.description: Finish the tutorial, win an Elite game, and beat the three act bosses. Play on Pro or higher so every counter is safe.

roadmap.title: Run feats and skill goals
roadmap.description: One-game and one-run feats, special shots, and ability goals that you can build a single run around.

roadmap.title: Roster, helmet and benchwarmer goals
roadmap.description: Free agent and relic unlock challenges, Golden Helmet goals, and the eight benchwarmer quests.

roadmap.title: Long counters and squad ladder
roadmap.description: Cumulative counters, opponent grinds, the hidden squad chain, and a winning run with every squad.

achievements.description: Complete the tutorial
achievements.summary: Finish the tutorial.

steps.text: From the home screen, go to the practice menu, launch the tutorial, and finish it.

achievements.description: Win a game versus an elite team
achievements.summary: Win a game against an Elite team.

guide.context: An Elite game has two 2-minute periods. Losing one ends the run. Act 1 Elite teams are Greasy Lettuce, Meatballs and Top Cheese.

steps.text: Pick an Elite game on the campaign map and win it.

achievements.description: Win an elite game with the mercy rule
achievements.summary: Win an Elite game by the mercy rule.

steps.text: Take an Elite game and score early.
Build a four-goal lead. The game ends at once and counts as a mercy-rule win.

achievements.description: Win act 1
achievements.summary: Win the Act 1 boss game against The Officials.

guide.context: A boss game has three 2.5-minute periods and ends at a six-goal lead. Losing ends the run.

steps.text: Play through Act 1 to its boss game.
Use Dash on the opening faceoff to steal the puck, then win the game.

achievements.description: Win act 2
achievements.summary: Win the Act 2 boss game against the Cup Cultists.

steps.text: Win Act 1, then play through Act 2 to its boss game and win it.

achievements.description: Win act 3
achievements.summary: Win the Act 3 boss game against the Golfers.

guide.context: This is the only boss game with no mercy rule, so it can run long.

steps.text: Win Act 2, then play through Act 3 to its boss game against the Golfers and win it.
Create rebounds and one-timers, and keep a teammate near the crease.

achievements.description: Win a run with every squad
achievements.summary: Win a run with every squad.

guide.context: There are 19 squads. A win with one squad does not count for another.

steps.text: On the squad selection screen, pick a squad with no crown and win a run with it.
Keep going until every squad has a crown.

achievements.description: Record 10 hat tricks
achievements.summary: Record 10 hat tricks.

steps.text: Feed your best scorer until that skater scores three goals in one game.
Repeat until you have recorded 10 hat tricks.

achievements.description: Unlock every free agent
achievements.summary: Unlock every free agent.

steps.text: Finish the unlock challenges that give free agents until the Unlockables menu shows none left.

achievements.description: Complete every benchwarmer quest
achievements.summary: Complete all eight benchwarmer quests.

steps.text: Finish each of the eight quests listed in the Unlockables menu.

achievements.description: Unlock every power-up and relic
achievements.summary: Unlock every power-up and relic.

steps.text: Finish the unlock challenges that give power-ups and relics until the Unlockables menu shows none left.

achievements.description: Score a goal with the headshot redirect
achievements.summary: Score a goal using the Headshot Redirect skill.

guide.context: A normal shot taken after a redirect does not count. The goal must come from the redirect.

steps.text: Put Headshot Redirect on a skater. Sergei Lancelov starts with it.
Use the skill so the puck deflects off a teammate's face toward the net, and score from it.

achievements.description: Score 1 yoyo goal
achievements.summary: Score a goal with the Yo-Yo skill.

guide.context: A normal shot after using Yo-Yo does not count. The goal must come from the pulled-back puck.

steps.text: Put Yo-Yo on the skater who will shoot. Calvin Dord starts with it.
Carry the puck into the attacking zone and press Yo-Yo to send the puck out.
Move to the side of or behind the net, then press Yo-Yo a second time so the puck flies back toward the goal.

achievements.description: Grow Gawain
achievements.summary: Make Gawain grow.

steps.text: Recruit Gawain. He can appear in a random event, and Superstar Selection offers him too.
Win the act with Gawain on your team. He grows after the win.

achievements.description: Knock out 50 opponents with a thrown stick
achievements.summary: Use thrown sticks to knock out 50 opposing skaters.

guide.context: Triple Twig lets you throw without losing your stick.

steps.text: Give a skater the Tomahawk skill. Rory McShaggy and Clementine McShaggy start with it.
Throw the stick at opponents until 50 are knocked out.

achievements.description: Register 40 shots in a game
achievements.summary: Register 40 shots in one game.

steps.text: Play a long game, such as a boss game, and shoot at every chance until you reach 40 shots.
Keep the score tied or close, because a game ended by the mercy rule cuts the count short.

achievements.description: Every player score 1 goal
achievements.summary: Have every skater on your team score a goal.

steps.text: Pass to a different skater each time you get a chance until every skater on your team has scored at least once.

achievements.description: Knock out every opposing skater on the ice at once
achievements.summary: Knock out all opposing skaters on the ice in the same moment.

guide.context: Knocking them down at different times does not count. All opponents must be down together.

steps.text: Take Challenge stops against the Spartans for a choice of three talents.
Marauder, Berserk and Home Wrecker make teammates check on their own; take them when offered.
Keep your skaters checking until every opponent on the ice is down at the same moment.

achievements.description: Heal 25 injuries
achievements.summary: Heal 25 injuries.

steps.text: Visit Infirmary stops and heal injured skaters until 25 injuries have been healed.

achievements.description: Score 5 goals with injured skaters in the same run
achievements.summary: Score five goals in one run from skaters who are injured at the time.

guide.context: The skater must still be injured when the goal is scored. Do not heal that skater early.

steps.text: Keep a skater injured and let that skater take the shots until five goals have come from injured skaters.

achievements.description: Trigger critical shots 8 times in the same game
achievements.summary: Trigger 8 critical shots in one game.

steps.text: Build critical chance with items such as Glass Cannon, Game Seven Glasses and Point Sniper.
Play a long game and shoot until eight critical shots have triggered.

achievements.description: Have 3 skaters with a fart power-up on the ice at the same time
achievements.summary: Get three skaters carrying fart power-ups onto the ice together.

guide.context: Trio Squad with no benchwarmer was easier for one player.

steps.text: Take fart-based talents and relics when they are offered, and give them to three different skaters.
Make sure all three are in the active lineup, not on the bench.

achievements.description: Fart while immune
achievements.summary: Use a fart while your skater is immune.

steps.text: Give a skater the Gas ability.
Use Gas while that skater has immunity, such as during Spin-O-Rama.

achievements.description: Have a skater with 100 shot power and 100 speed
achievements.summary: Own one skater whose Shot Power and Speed are both 100.

guide.context: One Training visit adds 8 points to a single attribute.

steps.text: Raise one skater's Shot Power and Speed to 100 each with Training stops and upgrades.
Check the skater's attribute screen to confirm both are at 100.

achievements.description: Score 25 one-timer goals
achievements.summary: Score 25 one-timer goals.

steps.text: Skate the puck out wide and hold it until the goalie turns to face you.
Pass across to a skater near the net and shoot at once without stopping the puck.

achievements.description: Recover from a 3 goal deficit and win the game
achievements.summary: Come back from three goals down to win a game.

steps.text: Fall three goals behind in a game, then come back and win.

achievements.description: Get injured 5 times while wearing the Golden Helmet
achievements.summary: Suffer five injuries to a skater who is wearing the Golden Helmet.

guide.context: The skater must be wearing the helmet when each injury happens.

steps.text: Let one skater score the most goals in the run to earn the Golden Helmet.
Keep that skater on the ice until the skater has been injured five times.

achievements.description: Play 10 games with a Golden Helmet wearer on the bench
achievements.summary: Play ten games while the Golden Helmet owner sits on your bench.

guide.context: Do not trade the wearer away. This cannot progress in the same game as the 200-Checking helmet goal.

steps.text: Let one skater score the most goals to earn the Golden Helmet.
Put that skater on the bench and play 10 games with that skater there.

achievements.description: Score a critical-shot goal while enraged
achievements.summary: Score a goal with a critical shot while enraged.

steps.text: Get enraged. Being knocked down does it, and Rage Release, Berzerker or Rage Switch can do it on purpose.
Take a critical shot while still enraged and score.

achievements.description: Get over 100 knockouts in a game
achievements.summary: Get over 100 knockouts in one game.

steps.text: Choose Violence Squad, where each successful body check knocks the target out.
Keep the game going and check as much as you can until the game total passes 100.

achievements.description: Visit Training 30 times
achievements.summary: Visit Training 30 times.

steps.text: Choose Training stops on the campaign map until you have visited Training 30 times.

achievements.description: Fart while knocked down
achievements.summary: Use a fart while knocked down.

steps.text: Give a skater the Gas ability.
Let an opponent knock that skater down, then press Gas right away.

achievements.description: Lose 10 runs
achievements.summary: Lose 10 runs.

steps.text: Lose runs. Losing an Elite or boss game ends a run.

achievements.description: Win a run with at least 3 S or XS characters in your active lineup
achievements.summary: Win a run whose active lineup holds three or more skaters of size S or XS.

guide.context: Small skaters on the bench do not count. Check sizes before the final game.

steps.text: Make skaters smaller with size-changing rewards, such as the Shrimp Squad relic, Evolution events or the Butcher's XS copy.
Put at least three S or XS skaters in the active lineup and win the run.

achievements.description: Hear 20 farts in a single game
achievements.summary: Hear 20 farts in one game.

steps.text: Build a lineup with Gas and other fart effects.
Use them in one game until you have heard 20 farts.

achievements.description: Have 3 players injured on the ice at the same time
achievements.summary: Play with three of your own skaters injured and on the ice together.

guide.context: Injured skaters on the bench do not count.

steps.text: Get three of your active skaters injured and keep them on the ice in the same game.

achievements.description: Have a Golden Helmet wearer with 200 checking
achievements.summary: Reach 200 Checking on a skater who wears the Golden Helmet.

guide.context: Heavy Helmet gives +100 checking, Bonecrusher +20, Marauder and Home Wrecker +30 each, Gigantism +10 to everyone, and The Original Glove doubles checking bonuses.

steps.text: Let one skater score the most goals to earn the Golden Helmet.
Stack checking boosts on that skater until Checking reaches 200. Sergei Lancelov starts at 120.

achievements.description: Injure your opponent 5 times in the same game
achievements.summary: Injure the other team 5 times in one game.

steps.text: Give skaters the Prod talent or other injury effects.
Use them on opponents until five injuries land in the same game.

achievements.description: Do 20 Slapshart or Shartslap
achievements.summary: Combine the Gas ability and a slapshot 20 times.

steps.text: Use Gas, then take a slapshot, or take a slapshot, then use Gas.
Repeat until the combination has happened 20 times.

achievements.description: Injure an opponent while enraged
achievements.summary: Injure an opponent while enraged.

steps.text: Get enraged. Being knocked down triggers it, and Rage Release triggers it when you shoot.
Injure an opponent while still enraged.

achievements.description: Froggify a referee
achievements.summary: Froggify a referee.

guide.context: The Act 1 boss must be the referees team, not the Prisoners. Referee Squad cannot be used, because that squad always plays the Prisoners.

steps.text: Before the Act 1 boss, get the Froggify special from a reward.
Before facing the referees, finish the final Elite game and look at the victory relic choices. If Froggify is missing, restart that match.
In the referees boss game, use Froggify on a referee.

achievements.description: Win against the Cultists 10 times
achievements.summary: Win against the Cultists 10 times.

steps.text: Win Act 2 boss games against the Cup Cultists until you have 10 wins.

achievements.description: Knock out the referee 100 times
achievements.summary: Knock out the referee 100 times.

steps.text: Take the Briberee relic when it appears. It makes the referee body check the other team.
Keep playing games with referees until the count reaches 100.

achievements.description: Become enraged 30 times in one game
achievements.summary: Get enraged 30 separate times within a single game.

steps.text: Take the Rage Release talent so every shot enrages you.
Shoot and get knocked down until you have been enraged 30 times in the same game.

achievements.description: Break 50 glass panes
achievements.summary: Break 50 glass panes.

guide.context: In the one-goal starting game you can keep trying as long as nobody scores.

steps.text: Skate behind the opponent's goal line and aim up with the stick before a charged slapshot.
Break panes until you reach 50.

achievements.description: Score a goal worth more than 1 goal 3 times
achievements.summary: Three times, score a goal that counts for more than a single goal.

steps.text: Take relics that raise goal value, such as Buzzer Beater, Coach's Grunt or Rage Burger, or a Money Puck.
Score with them until you have three goals worth more than one.

achievements.description: Have the same skater get 15 assists in a single run
achievements.summary: Have one skater get 15 assists in one run.

steps.text: Pick a skater to be your passer and pass back and forth before every shot, so that skater is credited with assists.
Keep this skater as your main passer for the whole run.

achievements.description: Break 50 sticks
achievements.summary: Break 50 sticks.

steps.text: Use Glass Cannon, which breaks the stick on non-critical shots, or other stick-breaking effects until 50 sticks have broken.

achievements.description: Have a single skater receive 3 injuries in the same run
achievements.summary: Have one skater get injured 3 times in one run.

steps.text: Do not bench anyone and play aggressively so the same skater keeps getting hurt.
Skip healing that skater until the third injury.

achievements.description: Use the Gas ability 50 times
achievements.summary: Use the Gas ability 50 times.

steps.text: Give a skater the Gas ability and press it whenever it is ready until you have used it 50 times.

achievements.description: Have a skater get 10 assists in a single run without scoring a goal
achievements.summary: Have one skater get 10 assists in one run without scoring a goal.

guide.context: A goal by that skater ends the attempt for the run. Trio Squad makes this easier.

steps.text: Pick a skater as your feeder and pass the puck through that skater before each shot.
Never let that skater shoot the puck into the net.

achievements.description: Win a run while your highest OVR skater has 0 goals
achievements.summary: Win a run in which your top-OVR skater never scores.

guide.context: Your highest OVR skater can change after upgrades.

steps.text: Check which skater has the highest OVR before every game.
Keep goals away from that skater. A deflection can still credit a goal, so check the goal totals.
Win the run.

achievements.description: Take a slapshot while your Slowmo ability is active
achievements.summary: Take a slapshot while Slowmo is active.

steps.text: Get a skater with the Slowmo ability. Angus Skip-Shaggy in All Angus Squad has it.
Turn Slowmo on, then take a slapshot.

achievements.description: Have a skater score in 8 consecutive games
achievements.summary: Have one skater score in 8 games in a row.

guide.context: A game without a goal from that skater resets the streak.

steps.text: Choose one reliable scorer and feed that skater every game.
Check that this skater has scored before each game ends.

achievements.description: Get knocked out by a Crusader goalie 10 times
achievements.summary: Be knocked out by Crusader goalies ten times.

steps.text: Win Act 1, then in Act 2 play Crusader games and skate close to their goalie to get knocked out.

achievements.description: Have 7 goalie assists in the same act
achievements.summary: Collect seven assists from your goalie within one act.

guide.context: Trio Squad makes this easier. The assist only counts if one or two passes follow, not three.

steps.text: Pass the puck back to your own goalie.
Once the goalie holds it, make one or two passes and score.
Repeat until the goalie has seven assists in the same act.

achievements.description: Injure 10 skaters
achievements.summary: Injure 10 skaters.

steps.text: Play normally and check; injuries will come. Take Prod if offered.

achievements.description: Knock out Bear Grohl 5 times
achievements.summary: Knock out Bear Grohl 5 times.

steps.text: Hit Bear Grohl with a large, high-checking skater.
Check him while enraged for the best chance.

achievements.description: Hook 50 opponents with the grapple
achievements.summary: Hook 50 opponents with the grapple.

steps.text: Give a skater the Grappling Hook skill. Frank Furter and Buck Wurst start with it.
Hook opponents until 50 have been hooked.

achievements.description: Activate the Magnet ability 25 times
achievements.summary: Use the Magnet ability 25 times.

steps.text: Give a skater the Magnet ability and use it whenever ready until 25 activations.

achievements.description: Score 5 goals with a skater who has 0 shot power
achievements.summary: Score five goals using a skater whose Shot Power stands at 0.

guide.context: Shot Power upgrades remove the 0 condition.

steps.text: Use a skater whose Shot Power is 0, such as Kelly Jelly, and do not raise it.
Score five goals with that skater.

achievements.description: Cause 20 puck losses with the kazoo
achievements.summary: Make opponents lose the puck 20 times with the kazoo.

steps.text: Give a skater the Kazoo skill. Gedeon Lamoustache starts with it.
Use it near puck carriers until 20 puck losses have been caused.

achievements.description: Use the Gas ability 100 times
achievements.summary: Use the Gas ability 100 times.

steps.text: Give a skater the Gas ability and press it whenever it is ready until you have used it 100 times.

achievements.description: Knock out 100 skaters from the Princess team
achievements.summary: Knock out a total of 100 Princess team skaters.

guide.context: Violence Squad makes every body check a knockout.

steps.text: Win Act 1, then play Princess Elite games in Act 2 and check their skaters until 100 are knocked out.

achievements.description: Yeet 25 skaters
achievements.summary: Yeet 25 skaters.

steps.text: Take the Yeet ability and use it on skaters until 25 have been yeeted.

achievements.description: Hit 20 opponents with the wet towel
achievements.summary: Land the wet towel on 20 opposing skaters.

steps.text: Take the Wet Towel ability and hit opponents with it until 20 have been hit.

achievements.description: Have a skater with all attributes at 90 or above
achievements.summary: Have a skater with every attribute at 90 or higher.

steps.text: Raise Speed, Checking, Shot Power and Accuracy on one skater to 90 or more with Training and upgrades.

achievements.description: Make 3 or more opponents dance at once with Disco
achievements.summary: Use Disco so that at least three opponents are dancing together.

steps.text: Give a skater Disco Dance. Ozzie Oioioi starts with it.
Skate to the opponent's net, wait until the other team gathers around, then use Disco.

achievements.description: Knock out Prince Tristan Arthur XIV 25 times
achievements.summary: Knock Prince Tristan Arthur XIV out 25 separate times.

steps.text: Target Prince Tristan Arthur XIV with body checks every time you play his team.
Keep going until he has been knocked out 25 times.

achievements.description: Injure 30 opponents
achievements.summary: Injure 30 opponents.

steps.text: Play with checking and injury effects and injure opponents until the count reaches 30.

achievements.description: Win 5 times against the Crusaders
achievements.summary: Win 5 times against the Crusaders.

steps.text: Win Act 1, then win games against the Crusaders in Act 2 until you have 5 wins.

achievements.description: Score 25 breakaway goals
achievements.summary: Score 25 breakaway goals.

steps.text: Win the puck on defense and skate in alone against the goalie.
Score on breakaways until you have 25.

achievements.description: Break 10 glass panes
achievements.summary: Break 10 glass panes.

steps.text: Skate behind the goal line and aim up on a charged slapshot to break panes.

achievements.description: Score 5 goals with a curve-ball shot
achievements.summary: Score five goals from curve-ball shots.

steps.text: Use the curve-ball shot and score with it five times.

achievements.description: Win one run using the General Manager squad.
achievements.summary: Win one run using the General Manager squad.

steps.text: Pick General Manager Squad on the squad selection screen and win a run with it.

achievements.description: Unlock 3 squads.
achievements.summary: Unlock 3 squads.

steps.text: Unlock squads by finishing their challenges until you have unlocked 3.

achievements.description: Lose 5 runs.
achievements.summary: Lose 5 runs.

steps.text: Lose runs. Losing an Elite or boss game ends a run.

achievements.description: Score 5 enraged goals in one run.
achievements.summary: Score 5 enraged goals in one run.

steps.text: Take the Rage Release talent so each shot enrages you.
Score five goals in the same run while enraged.

achievements.description: Get injured 10 times.
achievements.summary: Get injured 10 times.

steps.text: Play aggressively and let your skaters get hurt until 10 injuries have happened.

achievements.description: On Pro or above, win a run with each of three separate squads.
achievements.summary: On Pro or above, win a run with each of three separate squads.

steps.text: On Pro or above, win a run with each of three separate squads.

achievements.description: Stop at Training 50 times in total over all your runs.
achievements.summary: Stop at Training 50 times in total over all your runs.

steps.text: Choose Training stops on the map in every run until the total reaches 50.

achievements.description: Over all your runs, get 50 goals from slapshots.
achievements.summary: Over all your runs, get 50 goals from slapshots.

steps.text: Play Slapshot Squad or a slapshot build and score with slapshots until the total reaches 50.

achievements.description: Win a run with Trio Squad.
achievements.summary: Win a run with Trio Squad.

guide.context: Trio Squad has only three skaters.

steps.text: Pick Trio Squad and win a run with it.

achievements.description: Defeat the Referee team 10 times.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Referee team 10 times.

steps.text: Win games against the Referee team until you have 10 wins.

achievements.description: Unlock 10 free agents.
achievements.summary: Unlock 10 free agents.

steps.text: Finish unlock challenges that give free agents until 10 are unlocked.

achievements.description: On Pro or above, win a run with each of two separate squads.
achievements.summary: On Pro or above, win a run with each of two separate squads.

steps.text: On Pro or above, win a run with each of two separate squads.

achievements.description: Win one run on Pro, Veteran or Nightmare.
achievements.summary: Win one run on Pro, Veteran or Nightmare.

steps.text: Choose Pro, Veteran or Nightmare and win a run.

achievements.description: Unlock 4 benchwarmers.
achievements.summary: Unlock 4 benchwarmers.

steps.text: Finish unlock challenges that give benchwarmers until 4 are unlocked.

achievements.description: On Pro or above, win a run with each of six separate squads.
achievements.summary: On Pro or above, win a run with each of six separate squads.

steps.text: On Pro or above, win a run with each of six separate squads.

achievements.description: On Pro or above, win a run with each of ten separate squads.
achievements.summary: On Pro or above, win a run with each of ten separate squads.

steps.text: On Pro or above, win a run with each of ten separate squads.

achievements.description: Across all runs, score 200 goals as an Angus skater.
achievements.summary: Across all runs, score 200 goals as an Angus skater.

steps.text: Play with an Angus skater and score with him over many runs until the total is 200.

achievements.description: Have 17 unlocked squads.
achievements.summary: Have 17 unlocked squads.

steps.text: Unlock squads until 17 of the 19 are unlocked.

achievements.description: Knock down 10 skaters with a shot
achievements.summary: Use your shots to knock 10 skaters to the ice.

guide.context: The 10 skaters do not need to fall at once.

steps.text: Take the Sonic Slap talent or the Howitzer ability and shoot slapshots into skaters until 10 are knocked down.

achievements.description: Knock out 20 skaters on a breakaway with a bodycheck
achievements.summary: Body check 20 skaters who are on a breakaway and knock them out.

steps.text: Body check opponents who are on a breakaway until 20 are knocked out.

achievements.description: Knock 25 helmets off opponents
achievements.summary: Knock 25 helmets off opponents.

steps.text: Keep checking opponents until 25 helmets have come off.

achievements.description: Win 1 brawl
achievements.summary: Win 1 brawl.

steps.text: Win a brawl when one starts.

achievements.description: Score 15 goals with Kelly Jelly
achievements.summary: Score 15 goals with Kelly Jelly.

steps.text: Pick Kelly Jelly as your Superstar and score 15 goals with her.

achievements.description: Have 8 talents at the same time
achievements.summary: Have 8 talents on Boring Dude at the same time.

guide.context: All eight talents must be on Boring Dude, not spread over the team.

steps.text: Take Comfy Cushion if offered and put Boring Dude on its Bench so he gets a random talent after each game.
Take Coach's Favorite early so rewards keep going to him.
Keep going until Boring Dude has 8 talents at once.

achievements.description: Use your ability 100 times in a single run
achievements.summary: Use Buster Brewster's ability 100 times in one run.

steps.text: Give Buster Brewster a low-cooldown ability such as Gas, Dash, Wet Towel or Totally Normal Puck.
Use it every time it is ready, starting in the first game, until 100 uses in one run.

achievements.description: Get 200 knockouts in a single run
achievements.summary: Get 200 knockouts with Maurice Cassoulet in one run.

guide.context: The run can end in a loss.

steps.text: Play Violence Squad so body checks cause knockouts.
Give Maurice effects such as Bowling Pins, Eggsplosion, Chexplosion and Sonic Slap.
Keep him doing the checking until 200 in the run.

achievements.description: Shoot with at least 100% crit chance
achievements.summary: Take a shot with Ricky Kirby at 100% critical chance or more.

steps.text: Give Ricky Kirby critical-chance items such as Stix, Glass Cannon and Game Seven Glasses.
Shoot during the last 20 seconds of a period, when his critical chance reaches at least 100%.

achievements.description: Score 20 goals in a single run
achievements.summary: Score 20 goals with Freddy Kovalski in one run.

steps.text: Make Freddy Kovalski your main scorer and give him the shots.
Look for goal multipliers. Keep going until he has 20 goals in the run.

achievements.description: Mark Bench plays every game of the run and is never benched. Win the run
achievements.summary: Win a run with Mark Bench playing every game and never benched.

steps.text: Keep Mark Bench in the active lineup for every game of the run.
Protect him from injuries and win the run.

achievements.description: Score 10 enraged goals in a single run
achievements.summary: In a single run, have Sally Poppins score ten goals while she is enraged.

steps.text: Make Sally enraged with Rage Release, Berzerker or Rage Switch.
Shoot while she is enraged. Count ten goals in the same run.

achievements.description: Have 4 injuries at the same time
achievements.summary: Have 4 injuries on Stu Stumple at the same time.

steps.text: Look for the Infirmary/Butcher event that trades four injuries on a single skater for an XS copy, and choose Stu as that skater.
Or have a teammate use Prod on Stu until four injuries are active, and do not heal him.
